after.worked_solution:
Using the determinant formula, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}u\times v & =|\begin{aligned}i & j & k \\ 3 & 0 & -2 \\ -2 & 1 & 5\end{aligned}| \\  & =|\begin{aligned}0 & -2 \\ 1 & 5\end{aligned}|i-|\begin{aligned}3 & -2 \\ -2 & 5\end{aligned}|j+|\begin{aligned}3 & 0 \\ -2 & 1\end{aligned}|k \\  & =(0\cdot 5-(-2)\cdot 1)i-(3\cdot 5-(-2)\cdot (-2))j+(3\cdot 1-0\cdot (-2))k \\  & =(0+2)i-(15-4)j+(3-0)k \\  & =2i-11j+3k.\end{aligned}
$$
